subject: general
question: Which Indian non-profit organisation was named a 2025 Ramon Magsaysay Awardee for mobilising community and government resources to advance girls’ education in rural and educationally disadvantaged areas?

options.text: Foundation to Educate Girls Globally (Educate Girls)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Foundation to Educate Girls Globally (Educate Girls).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Ramon Magsaysay Foundation announced that Educate Girls__ has been named a __2025 Ramon Magsaysay Awardee__ for its work in girls’ education across rural and disadvantaged regions.**
